title: Power to make regulations
rule: The Minister may make regulations on felling, working, removal and transport of timber; on areas of unreserved land where timber may or may not be cut; and on licences, permits and fees.
points: This is the legal basis for the Regulations that hold the detailed harvesting and licensing rules.
Rules may set a fine up to TSh 500,000 or up to 6 months in prison, or both (s. 107(5)).
